facts.origin: Rock Hill, SC — 2BR apartment, one flight of stairs at origin
facts.inventory: 2BR standard: queen bed, sofa, dresser x2, dining set, ~40 boxes, no piano, no appliances

benchmarks.source: moveBuddha collected quotes — Rock Hill SC to Charlotte NC, 45 mi, 2BR standard service

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a buyer to gather moving quotes. Is now a good time?

transcript.speaker: vendor
transcript.text: Wait — am I talking to a robot?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes — I'm an AI assistant, and I'm calling with the buyer's permission on a fully confirmed job spec. Happy to share every detail; you'd deal with the buyer directly for booking.

transcript.speaker: vendor
transcript.text: Ha, alright. What's the job?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: 2-bedroom apartment, Rock Hill to Charlotte, 45 miles, one flight of stairs at origin, elevator at destination, standard inventory, August 1 with flexibility to August 6. How do you price it?

transcript.speaker: vendor
transcript.text: That's $2,480 all told: $1,300 labor, $450 truck and fuel, $275 stair carry, $200 materials, $150 long-carry fee, $105 fuel surcharge.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Two questions on fees. The destination has an elevator and loading dock, so what triggers the long-carry fee? And $275 for a single flight of stairs is above the $150 other companies quoted for this exact job.

transcript.speaker: vendor
transcript.text: Fair point on the dock — I'll waive the long carry. And I can do the stairs at $150. That puts you at $2,180.

quote.fees: Long-carry waived; fuel surcharge still on the quote

killed_fees.description: Long-carry fee — waived after elevator/dock challenge

negotiation_moves.lever: Fee challenge: elevator/dock kills long carry; stairs benchmarked at $150

transcript.speaker: agent

transcript.text: 2-bedroom apartment, Rock Hill to Charlotte, 45 miles, one flight of stairs at origin, elevator at destination, August 1 or flexible to August 6.

transcript.speaker: vendor

quote.fees: No additional fees; fuel surcharge waived when questioned

killed_fees.description: Fuel surcharge — dropped when double-billing questioned

negotiation_moves.lever: Questioned fuel surcharge double-billed inside the truck line

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a buyer for a moving quote. Is now a good time?

transcript.speaker: vendor
transcript.text: A robot, huh? Sure, whatever, what's the move?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes — an AI assistant, calling with the buyer's permission. The job: 2BR apartment, Rock Hill to Charlotte, 45 miles, one flight of stairs at origin, elevator at destination, August 1.

transcript.speaker: vendor
transcript.text: $1,195. Best price in the Carolinas, guaranteed.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's well below every other quote for this job. Could you itemize it — labor, truck, stairs, materials — and confirm whether it's binding?

transcript.speaker: vendor
transcript.text: We don't break it down, that's just the price. It's an estimate — final number depends what the crew finds on the day. We take 35% up front to lock the truck.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: So $1,195, non-binding, no itemization, 35% deposit, with day-of adjustments possible. I'll record it exactly that way. Available August 1?

transcript.speaker: vendor
transcript.text: Yeah, we can do the 1st.

quote.fees: Refused to itemize; day-of adjustments reserved
assumptions: Final price depends on what the crew finds on the day

red_flags.detail: $1,195 is 45% below the $2,170 market median for this exact job — the brief's own guidance flags anything 30%+ below as a warning sign, not a win
Vendor refused to break the price into labor, truck, stairs, or materials, making the quote impossible to compare or hold to
Explicitly non-binding with day-of adjustments reserved — the FMCSA lowball-then-upcharge pattern
35% deposit demanded up front ($418) against a non-binding number — money at risk before any commitment
